about: The Arena's figures: per card a front view (the rival's side) and a rear view (yours), at 2x (src) and 1x (lo), each with its foot anchor, opaque box, footprint and fx anchors (anchor: where its shots leave; core: its body's middle) in 2x px of src. A card with forms (Princeton TD) carries forms[key] = { front, rear } in the same view shape, all at one scale. parts are living layers: { name, view, src, motion, cells, w, h (one cell in file px), px (view px a file px; pixel: draw with image-rendering: pixelated), ms (each cell's hold; rate is the mean cells a second), loop, rest (the cell shown when it does not move), pivot (where a cell's top-left sits in the view's px), box and foot (its envelope and paws there, inside the view's box), fx (its own anchor and core while it shows), cover (while mounted it replaces the still outright) }. Paths are relative to this file. Copied from r4/stage/figures and the battle's own tools by .work/stage/build.mjs; never edit by hand.

princeton-td.native: one isometric view, aimed by the sprite rotation (CONTRACT §1 exception, Kevin 2026-11-10)
